title: URL Shortener
vague_prompt: Design a URL shortening service like bit.ly.
hidden_guidance: 100 million new links per day, and about 10 billion redirects per day
Read to write ratio about 100 to 1
Redirect latency target under 50 ms at p99
A short code must never repeat, and a redirect must point to the newest target after an edit
A link must stay valid for at least 5 years
Custom vanity codes are a paid feature and must be reserved for one owner
known_patterns: Base62 encoding of a counter or a hash
Key generation service that hands out preallocated counter ranges
Collision check when the code comes from a hash
301 for permanent links and 302 when click tracking is needed
Read path served from cache and CDN in front of the database
Separate read and write services because the read path carries most of the traffic
common_misses: Cache TTL and invalidation when a link target changes
Hot key problem for one viral link
Custom alias uniqueness and a reserved word list
Click analytics written off the redirect critical path
Cleanup and expiry of unused or dead links
